calibration_gate: At 90% intervals, coverage within three binomial standard errors of 0.9 and PIT KS <=1.63/sqrt(N), for learned and known-boundary models, both designs; prior-predictive scalar checks only
scope: Quasistatic one-plane bending; known reference geometry, cameras and correspondences; Gaussian-rendered illustrations, inference from noisy 2D center tracks. Material fixed, no trained encoder or flow-matching model.
stress_protocol: Three 400-case arms: off-grid boundaries only; shorter true force correlation length 0.8s only; both. Same force scale and material; no refitting. Separate arms added after initial combined stress failure.
